full_prompt_en: A square, highly realistic cinematic close-up shows an older man's face against a nearly black blue background. The crop is extremely tight: the left side of his face enters from the left edge, the nose projects toward the right, and the top of the forehead and lower chin are both cut by the frame. One eye near the upper-left center is sharply visible, its pale iris catching a small reflection. The farther eye sits close to the right edge of the face and is only partly seen beyond the nose bridge. Dark brows draw inward above a deep vertical crease, giving the man a concentrated, guarded expression. Fine lines fan outward from the nearer eye, while pores, folds, and uneven skin texture remain visible across the cheek and temple. His broad nose occupies much of the right-center, with its underside descending into a strongly shaded area above the mouth. The lips are closed and slightly pressed together; the lower face curves down into shadow at the bottom edge. Dark hair is only partly visible near the top and far left, merging with the background. A small mustard-yellow area of clothing enters at the bottom-left corner without revealing the full garment. Cool light grazes the nearer eye and cheek from the upper left, while a narrow warmer edge catches the nose and upper lip; the far side falls quickly into deep shadow. The overall composition fixes attention on the watchful eye through extreme cropping, tactile skin detail, and a restrained dark palette.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、高度写实的电影式特写在近乎黑色的蓝调背景前呈现一名年长男子的脸。裁切极紧：脸的左侧从左缘进入，鼻子向右突出，额头顶部和下巴下部都被画框截断。靠近左上中央的一只眼睛十分清楚，浅色虹膜里有一小点反光。较远的眼睛靠近脸的右缘，只在鼻梁后方露出一部分。深色眉毛在一道很深的竖向皱纹上方收紧，使男子显得专注而戒备。近处眼睛外侧放射出细纹，脸颊和太阳穴上的毛孔、褶皱与不均匀肤质仍可见。宽鼻子占据右中部很大区域，其下缘沉入嘴巴上方浓重的阴影。嘴唇闭合且轻轻抿住；脸的下半部沿底缘弯入暗影。深色头发仅在顶部和最左侧露出一部分，几乎融进背景。左下角有一小块芥末黄色衣料进入画面，却看不出完整服装。冷光从左上擦过近处眼睛与脸颊，一道较暖的边缘光照亮鼻子和上唇，远侧很快落入深影。整体构图借极近裁切、可触的皮肤细节与克制的暗色盘，把注意力固定在警觉的眼睛上。
style_prompt_en: Cinematic photorealism favors an extreme crop, shallow dark background, and painstaking skin texture. Cool blue-black shadow frames a narrow range of warm gray, taupe, and muted flesh tones, with very few colored accents. Raking side light reveals pores, creases, and raised planes through small value shifts; the opposite side drops rapidly into darkness. A selective catchlight creates a precise focal point, while nearby edges remain sharp and farther planes soften. The composition sacrifices complete form for tactile immediacy, using an off-center eye and large diagonal plane to hold tension. Surface detail stays natural rather than glossy or airbrushed. The overall effect is intimate, severe, and suspenseful.
style_prompt_zh: 电影感摄影写实偏爱极近裁切、浅而暗的背景和精细的皮肤肌理。冷蓝黑阴影围住暖灰、灰褐和低饱和肤色构成的狭窄色域，彩色重音极少。斜侧光借细小明度变化显出毛孔、皱纹和凸起色面，另一侧迅速沉入黑暗。选择性的眼中反光构成精确焦点，邻近边缘清楚，较远平面渐渐柔化。构图舍去形体的完整性，换取触手可及的近迫感，以偏离中心的眼睛和大块斜向平面维持张力。表面细节自然，没有光滑修饰感。整体效果亲密、严峻且充满悬念。
theme_en: An extreme close-up of a serious older man's face against darkness
theme_zh: 一名神情严肃的年长男子面部极近特写，背景深暗
